description: This file defines the AppDatabase class, which is a Room database class for managing local database operations related to ProductEntity in an Android application. It includes singleton pattern implementation for database instance management, and references the ProductDao interface for data access objects.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: An abstract class extending RoomDatabase, providing access to ProductDao and managing singleton instance of the database.

methods.name: productDao
methods.description: Abstract function that returns an instance of ProductDao for accessing product data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Companion object function to obtain the singleton instance of AppDatabase, creating it if necessary.
